name: Can I just paint over mildew on my bathroom ceiling?

mainEntity.name: Can I just paint over mildew on my bathroom ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard interior paint should not be applied over mildew; the mold must be completely eradicated first, and a mildew-resistant paint should be applied. Painting over active mildew simply traps the fungus, causing it to push through the fresh layer and ruin the finish. Clean affected areas with a fungicide or diluted bleach solution and allow the surface to dry completely. Following cleaning, apply a stain-blocking primer and a premium topcoat formulated with antimicrobial agents to inhibit future fungal growth in damp spots.
acceptedAnswer.description: No. Mildew must be fully cleaned and killed first; painting over it traps the growth and causes the new paint to fail and discolor quickly.
